name.en: Specialist in Occupational Safety and Health (HFP)
name.de: Expertin für Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz / Experte für Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz HFP
name.fr: Spécialiste de la sécurité au travail et de la protection de la santé DF
name.it: Specialista della sicurezza sul lavoro e della protezione della salute DPF

pathway.label: EFZ apprenticeship in a related occupation
pathway.note: Admission normally requires a relevant EFZ (3 or 4 years); the shorter variant is counted.

pathway.label: Preparation for the advanced federal exam: Expertin für Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz / Experte für Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz HFP
pathway.note: Duration of the preparatory course as stated; admission also requires professional experience (see exam regulations), so the true time to qualify is longer.

entryAccess.note: Admission to the federal exam is based on professional experience; no capacity limit.

meta.notes: Language regions assumed (all three) — not individually verified.  Occupation code matched approximately to SECO title 'Spezialist für Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz'.
